brand.meaning: normalized exact match to brands.name_fa, alias lookup allowed; empty = all

sort_tie_breaker: id ASC after primary sort; newest uses published_at DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC
filter_logic: AND across dimensions; bounds inclusive; payment uses EXISTS to avoid duplicate car rows

pagination.single_auto_append: fetch page=2&limit=10 once: append 11–20, deduplicate by id
pagination.boundary: do not auto-fetch page 3; reveal numbered pagination after result 20
pagination.explicit_mode: selecting page 3 replaces accumulated results with 21–30, moves focus to list heading, announces range
pagination.limit_change: 10, 20 or 50 allowed in explicit mode; reset to page 1 and remain explicit for this browsing session; UI mode is presentation state only, not a filter or cache key
pagination.direct_page_link: a deep link with page > 1 or limit != 10 renders one ordinary page without auto-append
pagination.filter_sort_change: reset page=1, limit=10 and append budget; abort outdated requests
pagination.back_forward: restore query and saved list mode / loaded pages / scroll from session history state; results still governed by URL
pagination.no_more: hide next when hasNext=false; page past last redirects to last valid page if total > 0; zero total remains page 1

url_state.canonical: single source of applied filters; useFilter is an application-level hook design, not an assumed third-party package
url_state.draft: sheet edits remain local until Apply; dismiss discards edits; Reset clears all filters
url_state.normalization: Unicode normalization, Persian/Arabic digit-to-ASCII parsing, whitespace trim, canonical parameter order, omit defaults, encode via URLSearchParams
url_state.sharing: same normalized URL and same inventory snapshot produce same filtered and sorted results; live inventory may change
url_state.history: push on Apply, sort, page or compare change; replace for canonicalization; do not push on every slider movement
url_state.cache: normalized public query only; private owner data is never in shared caches

validation: Reject unknown sort/enum, negative/invalid numbers, min > max and yearMin > yearMax with safe 400 field errors. Allowlist sort identifiers; values are parameterized. Never interpolate raw user SQL.
